question: A student proposes a design for a 'Figure-8' shaped loop (two loops of equal area twisted at the center) placed in a uniform magnetic field $B$. If the field $B$ starts increasing, predict the net induced EMF in the entire wire.

options.A: It will be double the EMF of a single loop.
options.C: It will be equal to the EMF of a single loop.
